{{Top|leg}}
'''Holofile 3F''' was the report [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Rolex]] filed during the trials of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] against the [[Bank of Aargau/Legends|Bank of Aargau]].<ref name="aargau">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20030807aargau|text=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs|int=Aargau: For All Your Banking Needs}}}}</ref>

The file detailed the damage that resulted from the [[Rigellian]]'s unsuccessful assassination attempt on Organa and [[Viscount (title)/Legends|Viscount]] [[Tardi]].<ref name="aargau" />
